content: निह्नवः .²1 Denial, concealment of knowledge; कार्यः स्वमतिनिह्नवः <ls>Māl. 1. 12</ls>; <ls>Chandr. 5. 27</ls>. .²2 Secrecy, concealment in general; निह्नवे याचितो दद्याद्धनं राज्ञे च तत्समम् <ls>Y. 2. 11</ls>, <ls n="Y. 2.">267</ls>. .²3 A secret. .²4 Mistrust; doubt, suspicion. .²5 Wickedness. .²6 Atonement, expiation; तस्यैष व्यभिचारस्य निह्नवः सम्यगुच्यते <ls>Ms. 9. 21</ls>. .²7 Contradiction. .²8 Obscuring, surpassing. .²9 Excuse, exculpation.
